title: Media schema formalization feeding lorebook knowledge and memories

sections.what: Formalize the `narrative.media` block in character persona as structured records (title, creator, genre, character reaction/affinity, key takeaways) that feed directly into the character's seeded memory store and lorebook knowledge rather than remaining an unread list.
sections.why: Characters often list favorite books, songs, games, or myths in their backstory. Currently, `narrative.media` is not an identity trait or GIMP dial; without formalizing its projection into memory records or lore knowledge, the field sits in the schema unread.
sections.how:
- In `engine/character_appearance.py`, define the schema for `narrative.media` entries (`title`, `medium`, `opinion`, `familiarity`).
- On initial scenario load or character hydration, generate semantic memory records (e.g. `You read 'The Art of War' and learned...`) with `source: "backstory"`.
- Add unit tests verifying that media items generate appropriate memory entries.

acceptance.text: Initial character hydration translates media entries into background memory records.
Media entries do not compile into physical appearance prose.

custom.verification:
